verdicts.reason: Stated by REQ-FUNC-001.
Gray-only crossing is stated.
At-most-one-bit-change per cycle is stated and is assertion-checkable.
Ordering and no loss or duplication are stated.
Write acceptance behaviour and condition are stated.
Read acceptance behaviour and condition are stated.
Pointer width and Gray register derivation are stated. It is a structural item verified by inspection.
Stated, but it restates AF-3-31 (see duplicates).
Power-of-2 depth, minimum 2 and no upper limit are stated.
Full flag requirement is stated. It is checkable against a model of accepted writes and reads.
The quote says o_full may stay 1 late, which is a permission.
Empty flag requirement is stated.
The quote says o_empty may stay 1 late, which is a permission.
Full-threshold behaviour is stated.
Empty-threshold behaviour is stated.
The occupancy definition uses internal binary and synchronized pointers, so it is not checkable from interface signals every cycle. Exercise it with scenarios instead of an assertion.
Static thresholds are a usage constraint stated for REQ-FUNC-010. It is a constraint with nothing to simulate.
Structural wrapper requirement is stated, verified by inspection.
Module partitioning is stated, verified by inspection.
Stage counts per option are stated.
The sync module contains no cells of its own and instantiates only the wrapper, per the quote.
Wrapper cell selection by PARA_AFIFO_CELL_TYPE is stated.
The quote is truncated here, but it is in the same requirement. Option 0 must not be used for Gray crossings, since the bypass has no stage.
Memory module independence and 1W1R SRAM model are stated.
The macro generate branch and RTL-array default are stated.
Show-ahead behaviour is stated.
Next-pointer read address and read every cycle are stated. They are exercised through o_rd_data.
Combinational flags are stated by REQ-FUNC-018.
Port list and parameter independence of the top ports are stated, verified by lint.
Fully asynchronous clocks with no frequency restriction are stated.
CDC structure rule is stated.
Read data path validity is stated, though vaguely.
Clock-domain partitioning is stated.

duplicates.reason: Both say the Gray pointer register launches the crossing with no logic between it and the synchronizer. AF-3-31 also covers the no-logic-between-stages part.

questions.question: REQ-FUNC-006 derives the Gray register from the next binary pointer, while REQ-FUNC-018 says flags are combinational from local pointer registers. Do the flags use the registered or the next pointer, and what is the exact full and empty equation, including the MSB inversion?

The occupancy estimate is the binary write pointer minus the binary read pointer, but only Gray pointers cross. Are the synchronized Gray pointers decoded to binary before the subtraction? Is the subtraction modulo 2^LPARA_PTR_W, and how is i_full_thr or i_empty_thr range handled?
The thresholds must not change while the FIFO is in use. What counts as 'in use' (after reset release?), and is any behaviour defined if they change?
Option 0 (bypass) is forbidden for Gray crossings. Is it allowed for the reset request and acknowledge synchronizers, and is it legal for the FIFO to operate with option 0 at all?
o_rd_data is said to show the word at the read pointer, including while empty. Yet the value is undefined while empty or before first write. What may a checker compare while o_empty=1?
